title: Strain-Gated Halo + Boundary Velocity Smoothing
hypothesis: Smoothing v_s across section boundaries with MASS-MOMENTUM weighting (weight each contributor, incl. self, by integrated VOLUME m_s; w = m * exp(-d^2/2sig^2)) stabilizes the per-section Cauchy strain; feeding that strain into the EXP-506 halo width (sigma_s *= 1+gamma* strain_s) widens the partition-of-unity blend ONLY at deforming seams, keeping the stitched Fiedler fault C0 under velocity shear. Mass is integrated VOLUME (LOD/coarsening-invariant), NOT leaf-count; EMA-stabilized against octant churn (Ghost #45). gamma=0 reproduces EXP-506.
operator_order: step(EXP-510) -> SMOOTH(mass-momentum v_bar) -> STRAIN(Cauchy ||Sym||) -> HALO(sigma gate)
backreaction_firewall: smoothing+strain are dual->dual; gate modulates an INTERPOLATION WIDTH (observability param), never leaf geometry or the eigenvector c. step() forward assignment is independent of the halo path.
engine_scope: GAME LAYER ONLY (multivelocity.py append + sectioned_fiedler.py additive halo params). No engine/*.py edits.
assertions_fork_A: [2] SAFETY: gamma_strain=0 -> stitched_fiedler byte-identical to EXP-506 (field+sigma)
[3] mass-weighting != distance-weighting; mass pulls light sliver toward heavy bulk MORE
[4] LOD-INVARIANCE: subdividing a section (same volume, more leaves) leaves mass-smoothing identical (volume!=count)
[5] strain-gated halo WIDENS under shear (mean sigma_gated > sigma_base)
[6] strain-gated halo ~UNCHANGED under rigid translation (sigma_gated == sigma_base within eps)
[7] smoothing reduces shimmer: peak-to-peak of mass-smoothed strain < raw strain under alternating jitter
[8] mass EMA continuous: |m_t - m_{t-1}| bounded under single-leaf churn
[9] determinism: re-run identical strain field + sigma (bit-stable)
[10] dual-only: step() matched sequence identical regardless of smoothing/halo (no backreaction)
